_note: The approach tool's numbers (pepin.tools.approach, pepin.stand_pose.Distances): written as config/knobs.json writes a knob (default, range, note), in a file of their own because the tools are no ROS node; read at every call, so an edit counts at the next request. A distance a person says replaces front_m or side_m for that request.

front_m.note: to, in front of, behind: metres from the target's point (a person's face, a thing's box) to base_link; base_link is 6 cm behind the bumper

side_m.note: right_of, left_of, beside: metres from the target's point to base_link, sideways in the target's frame

person_min_m.note: never nearer a person than this plus sigma_k sigmas of the depth they were measured at (a spoken distance included)

sigma_k.note: how many sigmas of the depth (stereo: z^2/27.5 * 0.5 px, 0.08 m at 2.2 m) are added to person_min_m; 2.0 until 2026-10-13, when run 11 ('подъедь ко мне', the face measured at ~2.2 m) stood the cart 0.42 m from the face instead of front_m 0.3 and, with the goal checker's 0.09 m short stop, 0.45 m from his shins: too far for the 0.3 m intent; 0: the costmap (the hull check, the planner) is the one source of standing distance, as Artem decided

ring_deg.note: the two alternatives turn the stand point this far about the target either way, same distance, when the planner refuses the first

head_moved_deg.note: a box of the last see() picture is refused when the head has turned more than this since: the box would point at something else; so is the person when the camera (the head and the cart together, TF's camera_link at their frame's stamp against the one after the depth pair) turned more than this between their frame and the depth pair

near_m.note: to: a robot already within its stand distance plus this of the target turns where it stands to face it instead of driving, so "come closer" never backs it away (0.15: a drive shorter than this is a shuffle inside the goal checker's 0.10 m)

face_wait_s.note: me, nobody in view: the body turns toward the person's voice (the speaker gaze's own turn, the whole bearing in one request) and the picture is read again once the turn ends; this is the longest the tool waits for that turn (a half turn at wheels.yaw_rate_deg_s 45 is 4 s, plus the arm's rest and the checks); 2026-10-13, Artem: the person behind the robot is the everyday case

sighting_age_s.note: me: the newest sighting of the person (the camera channel's record, by its exposure stamp against the goal server's clock, TF's) is refused as stale when older than this, never placed: 2026-10-14, a face seen during the gaze's own turn was placed with the poses of after it and the cart drove 4.9 m into the kitchen; a sighting is placed with TF's poses at its own stamp, so this bounds only how far the person may have walked since (1.5 s at a walk is about 2 m)
